key_insight: MMIR-TCM combines memory-based tongue segmentation, multimodal diagnosis, and retrieval-augmented reasoning to better support Traditional Chinese Medicine decision-making from tongue images and text.
clinical_relevance: The framework aims to make TCM diagnostic support more consistent and evidence-grounded, which could improve reproducibility in syndrome differentiation and prescription generation.
method: Memory-SAM performs training-free tongue segmentation for robust extraction.
Qwen3-VL is fine-tuned to generate structured tongue diagnosis from multimodal inputs.
A Qwen3-based RAG module produces evidence-grounded clinical decision support.
evidence_signal: The paper introduces MedTCM as a new large-scale multimodal dataset and TDEU as a domain-specific evaluation metric designed to better capture clinical accuracy than standard metrics.
watch_item: Performance claims depend on a new dataset and custom metric, so external validation and real-world clinical testing are still important before broad use.
paper_title: MMIR-TCM: Memory-Integrated Multimodal Inference and Retrieval for TCM Clinical Decision Support
